```{=html}
      Our wedding is taking place at the Fontainebleau Inn in Alpine, New York. The Inn sits on
      Cayuta Lake, just south of and in between Cayuga and Seneca lakes.
    </p>

        <h3>Airports</h3>
        <p>Ithaca Tompkins (ITH) is closest. Syracuse (SYR) and Elmira (ELM) are further out but often cheaper, with more flights.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="detail-card">
        <div class="day">Getting around</div>
        <h3>Rent a Car</h3>
        <p>Downtown Ithaca and Watkins Glen are walkable, but the surrounding area is rural, so you may want a car to explore. Ubers and rideshares can be difficult to get.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="detail-card">
        <div class="day">On the day</div>
        <h3>The Shuttle</h3>
        <p>We will run a shuttle from downtown Ithaca to the venue, with an earlier and a later shuttle back downtown. Times to come.</p>
      </div>

    <p class="eyebrow" style="text-align:center">Where to stay</p>

    <h2 class="section-title" style="text-align:center">Downtown Ithaca</h2>

    <div class="note-strip">
      Most people will probably want to stay in downtown Ithaca. It is the easiest hub &mdash;
      walkable to restaurants and the Commons, plenty to do, and it is where the shuttle runs
      from. We are not doing a room block, so book on your own. Below are our recommendations
      for staying downtown.
    </div>

    <div class="tbl-wrap">
```

| Where | The vibe | Address | |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Canopy by Hilton Ithaca Downtown** | The newest of the three. Bright, modern rooms on the edge of the Commons. | 324 E State St, Ithaca | [Book](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/ithcapy-canopy-ithaca-downtown/) |
| **Ithaca Marriott Downtown on the Commons** | Directly on the Commons, with a rooftop bar. The most rooms of the three. | 120 S Aurora St, Ithaca | [Book](https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/ithdt-ithaca-marriott-downtown-on-the-commons/overview/) |
| **Argos Inn** | A restored 1831 brick mansion with a handful of individually designed rooms and a cocktail bar downstairs. | 408 E State St, Ithaca | [Book](https://argosinn.com/) |

```{=html}

<section class="band band-shells">
  <div class="band-inner">

    <p class="eyebrow" style="text-align:center">Closer to the venue</p>

    <h2 class="section-title" style="text-align:center">Trumansburg &amp; Watkins Glen</h2>

    <p style="text-align:center; max-width:660px; margin:0 auto; line-height:1.8">
      Both towns have plenty to do on their own. Trumansburg is about forty minutes from the
      venue and is where the Friday welcome party is; Watkins Glen is about twenty-five.
    </p>

    <div class="listing">

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Gothic Eves Inn &amp; Spa</h4>
        <div class="place">Trumansburg</div>
        <p>An 1855 inn with a spa and a well-regarded breakfast.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Inn B Tween Farm B&amp;B</h4>
        <div class="place">Trumansburg</div>
        <p>An 1848 farmhouse with five country rooms and a farm-to-table breakfast.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>The Blackberry Inn</h4>
        <div class="place">Watkins Glen</div>
        <p>Three rooms in the village, walkable to Seneca Lake and the state park.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Finger Lakes Cider House</h4>
        <div class="place">Interlaken</div>
        <p>Two yurts and a three-bedroom loft above the tasting room, on an orchard farm.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Lake houses on Cayuta</h4>
        <div class="place">Alpine</div>
        <p>Several rental houses within walking distance of the Inn. Ask us for the list.</p>
      </div>

    </div>
```
